title: Transport Polynomial Exactness for Direct ALE-DG Methods with Nonsmooth mesh motion: A Conservative Coefficient-Evolution Framework
summary: High-order direct arbitrary Lagrangian--Eulerian discontinuous Galerkin (ALE-DG) methods can suffer severe order reduction under nonsmooth mesh motion despite satisfying the geometric conservation law (GCL). To address this limitation, we propose a new ALE-DG framework applicable to moving triangular and quadrilateral meshes. This framework successfully overcomes the uniform Lipschitz constraint inherent in existing direct ALE-DG methods, retaining high-order accuracy even when the mesh-velocity gradients are unbounded.
